modes.definition_zh: 面对强敌四周的联盟包围，不与联盟正面为敌，而是'事一强以攻众弱'——以超强为轴心，逐国拆解包围网成员与其轴心对手的关系，把多边形战场化简为一个个双边关系。要害有三：其一，连横是合纵的镜像运算——合纵要把诸弱焊成一个整体，连横则要在诸弱之间逐个插入楔子，每一桩双边结盟都是对多边联盟的一次切割；其二，破纵的顺序服从'先击枢纽'原则——齐楚是合纵的两大支柱，张仪入楚拆齐楚之交，即斫断合纵的承重梁，余者随之松动；其三，连横不靠武力压制而靠'利害重算'——向每一国证明'与秦盟则安、从纵盟则危'，让成员在算术上自行退出联盟。方法论签名：破一个联盟，不必打败它，只需让它的成员各自重新算账。
modes.definition_en: When encircled by a hostile coalition, do not fight it head-on: 'serve one strong power to attack the many weak'—make the superpower your axis and dismantle each member's ties to the rival axis, reducing a polygonal battlefield to a chain of bilateral relationships. Lianheng is the mirror operation of Hezong: where the vertical alliance welds the weak into one body, the horizontal alliance drives a wedge between each pair. Sequence follows the keystone rule—Qi and Chu were the coalition's pillars, so Zhang Yi struck at the Qi-Chu bond first, felling the load-bearing beam. And the wedge is not force but re-arithmetic: prove to each state that 'allied with Qin is safe, with the vertical alliance is doomed,' and members exit by their own calculation. Signature: to break a coalition you need not defeat it—only make each member re-run the numbers.
modes.source_chapter: 《战国策·秦策一》'张仪说秦王'；《史记·张仪列传》连横诸段
process_zh: 测绘联盟结构：摸清包围网各成员的力量、诉求与相互猜忌，标定联盟的枢纽国与最薄弱环节
选定突破顺序：先攻枢纽（齐楚之交），后取外围——承重梁一断，整座联盟大厦自行倾斜
逐国双边化：以'与秦盟则安'的利害账逐国重算，把每个成员从多边义务拉回双边交易
回收红利：成员退盟后顺势纳入连横体系，使瓦解出的每一块碎片都变成秦的缓冲与跳板
process_en: Map the coalition: survey members' strength, demands and mutual suspicion; mark the keystone states and the weakest link
Choose the breach order: strike the keystone (the Qi-Chu bond) first, the periphery second—cut the load-bearing beam and the whole structure tilts
Bilateralize one by one: re-run each member's interest arithmetic ('safe with Qin'), pulling each from multilateral obligation back to bilateral bargain
Harvest: fold each defector into the horizontal system, turning every broken fragment into Qin's buffer and springboard
modes.key_quote_zh: 连横者，事一强以攻众弱——破纵不在战胜，而在使各国各自算账。
modes.key_quote_en: Lianheng serves one strong power to attack the many weak—a coalition is broken not by victory but by making each member re-run its own numbers.
representative_cases_zh: 瓦解齐楚之交（前313年）：张仪以'秦愿献商於之地六百里'为饵诱楚绝齐，齐楚联盟一断，合纵东翼即塌——六国纵约自此再未能复原
连横定六国：张仪先后说魏、楚、韩、齐、赵、燕皆令'事秦'，以一使之力将合纵六国逐一翻转为连横成员——魏纳上郡、韩献宜阳、燕献桓山之尾五城
反例警示：张仪死后，六国复纵而纵约屡合屡散——连横破的是'联盟结构'而非'联盟动机'，一旦拆解者不在，各国趋利避害的算盘会重聚成纵
representative_cases_en: Breaking the Qi-Chu bond (313 BC): Zhang Yi baited Chu with a promised 600 li of Shang land to sever ties with Qi; the eastern wing of the vertical alliance collapsed and never recovered
Horizontalizing the six states: one by one Zhang Yi persuaded Wei, Chu, Han, Qi, Zhao and Yan to 'serve Qin'—Wei ceded Shangjun, Han yielded Zhiyang, Yan gave five cities

Counter-case: after Zhang Yi's death the states repeatedly re-formed the vertical pact, and it repeatedly frayed—Lianheng breaks the coalition's structure, not its motive; without a demoliisher, self-interest regroups into vertical alliance
modern_applications_zh: 商业竞争中巨头对竞争者联盟的逐个收编与分化
联盟谈判中的双边化拆解：把多边僵局化为成对交易
地缘政治中的楔子战略（wedge strategy）
反垄断审查中拆解卡特尔的结构分析
modern_applications_en: A dominant firm peeling rivals' alliance members one by one
Bilateralizing multilateral negotiation deadlocks into paired deals
Wedge strategy in geopolitics
Structural analysis for cartel dissolution in antitrust

modes.definition_zh: 不预设固定立场，把自身战略看作随'势'（格局走向）与'权'（力量对比）实时重排的函数：势合则进，势去则转，一切承诺都标注有效期。要害有三：其一，先辨'势'再定'策'——张仪每至一国先判该国处于合纵之'势'还是连横之'势'，顺势者借力，逆势者拆力，从不逆势硬顶；其二，权变的对象是立场而非目标——目标始终是'强秦弱诸侯'，可变换的只是今日事齐还是事秦的立场，立场为目标让路而非相反；其三，变中有常——权变不是机会主义漂移，'事强'的轴线恒定，只是轴心国的化名在换。方法论签名：立场可以天天换，目标不能季季换；会变的是路，不变的是去处。
modes.definition_en: Hold no fixed position: treat your strategy as a function re-solved in real time against the configuration (势, where the game is heading) and the balance (权, who outweighs whom). Advance when the configuration converges, pivot when it dissolves, stamp every commitment with an expiry date. First read the configuration before setting the play—Zhang Yi, arriving at each court, judged whether it lived inside a vertical or horizontal momentum, riding the one and dismantling the other, never butting head-on against the current. What adapts is the position, not the objective: the goal stayed 'strengthen Qin, weaken the lords,' while today's stance—serve Qi or serve Qin—rotated freely. And within change there is constancy: the axis 'serve the strong' never moved; only the axis power changed names. Signature: positions may change daily; the destination may not change seasonally. The road turns; the destination does not.
modes.source_chapter: 《战国策·秦策一》'张仪说秦王曰'；《史记·张仪列传》
process_zh: 读势：持续监测各国的实力消长与联盟聚散，判断当前格局的主导走向
称权：对照自身与各方的力量对比，标定可进可退的空间
换位不换向：在既定目标轴线上重新选择立场，逆势者拆、顺势者借
留退路：任何承诺预设退出条件，势变则约废——从不把自己锁死在昨日的格局里
process_en: Read the configuration: track shifts in power and coalition cohesion; judge the dominant drift of the board
Weigh the balance: compare forces, mark the corridor in which you can advance or retreat
Re-position without re-aiming: reselect your stance along the fixed objective axis—dismantle against the current, ride with it
Keep exits open: pre-set withdrawal conditions in every commitment; when the configuration turns, the pact lapses—never lock yourself inside yesterday's board
modes.key_quote_zh: 事一强者以定势——势合则进，势去则转，权变有常向。
modes.key_quote_en: Serve the strong to fix the configuration—advance as it converges, pivot as it dissolves; adaptation keeps one constant heading.
representative_cases_zh: 相魏而实为秦：张仪辞秦相而入魏为相，表面事魏、实际为秦拆散五国合纵——位置在魏，方向在秦，一身两任演示'换位不换向'
说楚先许后收：对楚怀王先许六百里后改口六里，当'势'已达成（齐楚绝交）即弃'约'如敝屣——承诺的有效期只到目标完成为止
反例警示：屈原等守约派以'信'责秦，却在变化的格局里固守死约——不知权变的守信，在战略上等于替对手守住自己的僵硬
representative_cases_en: Chancellor of Wei, agent of Qin: Zhang Yi resigned Qin's chancellorship to become Wei's chancellor—ostensibly serving Wei, actually dismantling the five-state vertical alliance for Qin. Position in Wei, direction toward Qin: one man, two offices, 're-positioning without re-aiming'

Promise, deliver, discard: having baited King Huai of Chu with 600 li and delivered 6 li, the moment the configuration's goal (the Qi-Chu break) was achieved the pledge was scrapped—commitments valid only until the objective completes
Counter-case: Qu Yuan's faction charged Qin with faithlessness while holding a dead pact inside a shifting board—faithfulness without adaptability is, strategically, rigidity in the enemy's service
modern_applications_zh: 商业战略中的立场-目标分离：战术联盟可换，战略定位不动
期权式承诺管理：为每个合作附设退出条款
地缘政治中的对冲战略
敏捷组织的战略回转机制
modern_applications_en: Position-objective separation in business strategy: swap tactical alliances, keep the strategic anchor
Option-style commitment management with pre-negotiated exits
Hedging strategy in geopolitics
Strategic pivoting mechanisms in agile organizations

modes.definition_zh: 不动刀兵而移人之国，靠的是把'利'造成一枚定向的钩子：先摸清对方的贪欲所在，再设计一个对方自以为算得赢的利益方案，诱其按己方预设的方向行动。要害有三：其一，钩子的规格按对方胃口定制——楚怀王贪地，故以'六百里商於之地'为饵；饵的大小要大到令人心动、又虚到可以改口；其二，利益诱导的真正指向是'隔离'而非'给予'——饵的目的是让楚国与齐国绝交、自我拆掉联盟，而非真的让楚国得地；其三，诱与骗只隔一层窗户纸：利导的高段位在于对方中计后仍以为是自己算赢——决策的心理账户归对方，后果的账单也归对方。方法论签名：最高明的贿赂，是让对方为出卖自己而开心。
modes.definition_en: Move a state without an army: forge 'interest' into a directional hook. First map the target's appetite; then design a windfall the target believes it can win, luring its action along the course you pre-set. The hook is custom-fitted to the appetite—land-hungry King Huai of Chu got the offer of 600 li of Shang land, sized large enough to dazzle and vague enough to renege. The real aim of the bait is isolation, not giving: its purpose was to make Chu break with Qi and demolish its own alliance, not to enrich Chu. And between inducement and deception lies only a membrane: at the highest grade, the target, once hooked, still believes it out-negotiated you—the psychological account of the decision is the target's own, and so is the invoice. Signature: the cleverest bribe makes the mark happy to sell himself.
modes.source_chapter: 《史记·张仪列传》'秦欲伐齐，齐楚从亲，患之……乃佯去秦，委质事楚'；《战国策·楚策一》
process_zh: 测绘贪欲：摸清决策者最在意、最想立刻兑现的利益是什么
定制饵料：设计一个对方自认为可赢、且能把对方推向'自我拆盟'方向的具体利益方案
诱其自断：让对方的贪婪完成隔离工作——与盟友交恶、自我孤立，全程无需己方动手
收网改账：目标达成后按己方的新解释重写承诺条款，把违约成本转嫁给已经孤立的对方
process_en: Map the appetite: learn what the decision-maker craves most and wants cashed soonest
Custom-build the bait: design a concrete windfall the target believes it can win, angled to push it toward self-dismantling of its own alliance
Let greed do the isolating: the target quarrels with its ally and isolates itself—your hand never moves
Rewrite the invoice: once the goal is met, reinterpret the pledge under your own reading and shift the default's cost onto the now-isolated target
modes.key_quote_zh: 以利导之——秦之得楚，非以兵取，乃以饵钓。
modes.key_quote_en: Guide by interest—Qin won Chu not by arms but by angling with bait.
representative_cases_zh: 商於六百里诱楚绝齐（前313年）：张仪见楚怀王，许'秦齐楚三国盟约之外，愿以商於之地六百里献楚'，楚王大悦，群臣皆贺，独陈轸冷警——楚遂绝齐约，遣使入秦受地
六里改口：楚使至秦受地，张仪称'仪与楚王约六里，不闻六百里'——饵的兑现规模从许诺时的'国'缩水为'邑'，而楚国已因绝齐而失去议价筹码
反例警示：陈轸之谏（'秦必负王，齐秦亦将视楚为市贾'）未被采纳——被饵钩住的组织，最先失去的恰恰是能听见警讯的耳朵
representative_cases_en: 600 li of Shang to bait Chu out of Qi (313 BC): Zhang Yi promised King Huai a gift of 600 li of Shang land 'beside the Qin-Qi-Chu pact'; the king rejoiced, his court congratulated, only Chen Zhen demurred—Chu broke with Qi and sent envoys to collect

Six li, not six hundred: at Qin the envoy was told 'I agreed on six li with your king, never six hundred'—the bait shrank from a state's territory to a hamlet exactly when Chu, having broken with Qi, had lost its bargaining chips
Counter-case: Chen Zhen's warning ('Qin will betray you; Qi and Qin will price you like a merchant') went unheeded—an organization hooked by bait first loses the ears that could have heard the alarm
modern_applications_zh: 并购谈判中的排他条款设计：以小利诱对手自我拆散其他交易
渠道竞争中的定向返点与排他协议
行为经济学中的激励设计与'诱饵效应'
情报行动中的诱导性收买
modern_applications_en: Exclusivity clauses in M&A: small inducements to make a target unwind its other deals
Targeted rebates and exclusivity contracts in channel competition
Incentive design and decoy effects in behavioral economics
Inducement operations in intelligence tradecraft

modes.definition_zh: 外交场上的胜负手在于让对方在虚实之间无法定价：以实兵撑虚言，以虚言省实兵——虚的部分制造想象空间（承诺、恐吓、前景），实的部分锚定可信度（军队、已兑现的旧账、既成事实），虚实比例随对手心理实时调配。要害有三：其一，虚必须挂在实上才有效——张仪的每一句大话背后都有秦军的真实存在，'秦地半天下、兵敌四国'不是修辞而是让对方自行验算的资产负债表；其二，实的成本用虚来摊薄——真正调动的军队有限，大部分威慑由对方的想象补足；其三，虚实的切换要踩在对方的验证周期之前——等对方验证完毕，格局已定。方法论签名：让对方的想象力为你出兵。
modes.definition_en: The winning move is to make the adversary unable to price your words between void and real: prop hollow words with real arms, and economize real arms with hollow words. The void creates imaginative space (promises, threats, prospects); the real anchors credibility (armies, honored old debts, accomplished facts); the mix is tuned in real time to the opponent's psychology. The void works only when hung on the real—behind every grand claim stood the fact of Qin's army, and 'Qin holds half the world' was a balance sheet the target was invited to audit, not rhetoric. The real's cost is amortized by the void: the troops actually moved were few; the opponent's imagination supplied the rest. And the void-real switch must land inside the opponent's verification window—by the time verification completes, the board is set. Signature: draft the opponent's imagination into your army.
modes.source_chapter: 《史记·张仪列传》'仪以横说诸侯，未尝有约而秦愿献商於之地'；《孙子兵法·虚实篇》的张仪式应用
process_zh: 立实点：先固定一两件无可辩驳的实——秦军的战力、既往履约或毁约的记录、已完成的兼并
张虚网：在实点之上张开承诺与恐吓的想象网，规模大于实而方向精确
调配比：依对手多疑或轻信的程度实时调配虚实比例——对轻信者增虚，对多疑者增实
抢验证：在对方完成信息验证之前锁定既成事实，让怀疑失去追认的对象
process_en: Plant the real: fix one or two irrefutable facts first—Qin's arms, past records of honoring or defaulting, accomplished annexations
Spread the void: over the real, stretch a web of promises and threats larger than fact but precise in direction
Tune the mix: adjust the void-real ratio to the target's gullibility or suspicion—more void for the credulous, more real for the skeptical
Outrun verification: lock in accomplished facts before the target finishes its checks, leaving doubt nothing left to certify
modes.key_quote_zh: 虚言实兵——秦地半天下，兵敌四国：让对方为你的威慑想象力买单。
modes.key_quote_en: Hollow words, real arms—'Qin holds half the world, its troops rival all four quarters': make the opponent's imagination pay for your deterrence.
representative_cases_zh: 楚怀王的验证悲剧：楚使在秦等了三个月受地不得，误以为齐秦已 secretly 结盟，怒而再绝齐——张仪用时间差让楚国自己给虚假信息补足了验证
胁韩魏以虚声：张仪说魏'秦兵之攻魏也，十日之内外',以精确的行军日程把想象变成可怖的算术——魏献上郡十五县
反例警示：张仪的虚言在秦国内部亦有对手（陈轸、昭雎屡屡拆穿其诈）——虚实之术依赖信息封锁，一旦对手有多渠道情报源，虚网即穿
representative_cases_en: King Huai's verification tragedy: Chu's envoys waited three months in Qin for the land; mistaking silence for a secret Qin-Qi pact, Chu furiously cut Qi again—Zhang Yi let Chu complete the verification of false intelligence itself, on schedule
Overawing Han and Wei with precise dread: telling Wei 'Qin's attack will land within ten days' turned imagination into terrifying arithmetic—Wei ceded fifteen counties of Shangjun

Counter-case: inside Qin, Chen Zhen and Zhao Ju repeatedly exposed Zhang Yi's fabrications—void-real craft depends on information blockade; with multi-source intelligence on the other side, the void net tears
modern_applications_zh: 战略威慑中的模糊性策略（strategic ambiguity）
商业谈判中的BATNA管理与虚位选项
信息时代的深度伪造与反制：验证周期攻击
创业融资中的'虚实平衡'：真实traction支撑愿景叙事
modern_applications_en: Strategic ambiguity in deterrence
BATNA management and phantom options in negotiation
Deepfake-era verification-window attacks and their counters
Void-real balance in startup fundraising: real traction undergirding the vision narrative

modes.definition_zh: 游说与谋略的一切花巧都压在一杆秤上：入一国之先，必先量其地之广狭、粮之多少、兵之强弱、君之明暗、臣之忠奸、民之苦乐——把对方的国家翻成一页可计算的资产负债表，再决定说什么、不说什么、向谁说。要害有三：其一，量权先于开言，'口'是最后出动的兵器——张仪每说一国，说辞里引用的山川、关隘、里程、兵力皆可核对，威慑的精度来自情报的精度；其二，量权是双向的——既量对手的国力，也量自己的筹码与退路，谋略的第一戒律是'打不赢的仗不开口'；其三，权重是动态的——每完成一轮博弈即更新账本，昨日的强国可能已是今日的弱邦。方法论签名：没有情报的雄辩，是对着靶子闭眼开枪。
modes.definition_en: All the glamour of persuasion rests on one scale: before entering any state, weigh its territory and granaries, its troops, its ruler's insight, its ministers' loyalty, its people's misery—translate the state into a single page of auditable balance sheet, then decide what to say, what to withhold, and to whom. Measurement precedes speech: the mouth is the last weapon deployed. Every mountain pass, mileage and troop figure in Zhang Yi's speeches was checkable—the precision of the threat came from the precision of the intelligence. Weighing is two-sided: you size the adversary's power and your own chips and exits alike; the first commandment is 'never open your mouth over a battle you cannot win.' And the ledger is live: each round of the game updates it—yesterday's strong state may be today's weak one. Signature: eloquence without intelligence is firing at a target with your eyes shut.
modes.source_chapter: 《鬼谷子·权篇/量权》之张仪实践；《战国策》张仪说辞所引山川兵数
process_zh: 建账：把目标国的地、粮、兵、政、君、臣、民逐项折算为可比较的量
对照：把自己一方的筹码、盟友与退路放上同一杆秤，得出胜率区间
定策：胜率足则进言，不足则改道——说辞的每一句都从账本里来
更新：每轮博弈结束即重估双方权重，删除过期的强与弱
process_en: Build the ledger: convert the target state's land, grain, troops, governance, ruler, ministers and people into comparable quantities
Counterweigh: place your own chips, allies and exits on the same scale; derive the win-probability band
Decide: speak when the odds suffice, reroute when they do not—every sentence of the pitch comes off the ledger
Update: re-weigh both sides after each round; delete expired strengths and weaknesses
modes.key_quote_zh: 量权度力——不量敌之长短，不知己之有余不足，而言战者妄也。
modes.key_quote_en: Weigh power, size strength—to speak of war without measuring the foe's long and short, and one's own surplus and deficit, is folly.
representative_cases_zh: 说魏的精确账目：'魏地方千里……卒不过三十万，地四平，诸侯四通辐辏，无名山大川之限'——以可核对的地理与兵力数据构成魏国无险可守的论证，魏王遂纳上郡之请
对楚怀王的心理量权：量得楚王贪而轻信、群臣异心，故饵以六百里而楚必动——对'人'的量权与对'国'的量权并重
反例警示：楚怀王绝齐之后才复盘齐楚之盟的价值——账本在决策之后才翻开，恰是量权之术的反面教材
representative_cases_en: A precise ledger for Wei: 'a thousand li square... no more than three hundred thousand troops, four-square plains, spokes to every state, no mountains or rivers for a rampart'—checkable geography and troop counts built the case that Wei could not hold; the king ceded Shangjun
Psychological sizing of King Huai: measuring the king as greedy and credulous with a divided court, Zhang Yi knew the 600-li bait would move him—sizing the man mattered as much as sizing the state
Counter-case: King Huai audited the worth of the Qi-Chu alliance only after breaking it—opening the ledger after the decision is the exact inversion of this method
modern_applications_zh: 尽职调查与竞争情报：先建账后开价
军事情报中的净评估（net assessment）
投资决策的双向风险量化
商务谈判前的对手画像与筹码清点
modern_applications_en: Due diligence and competitive intelligence: build the ledger before quoting a price
Net assessment in military intelligence
Two-sided risk quantification in investment decisions
Counterparty profiling and chip inventory before negotiation

modes.definition_zh: 不制造潮流，只捕捉并放大既有潮流：格局中已经存在的矛盾、恐惧与贪欲是免费的燃料，谋略家的全部工作是把它们引向对自己有利的出口。要害有三：其一，'势'在对方内部——齐楚之疑、韩魏之惧本已存在，张仪只是把这些互疑的点连成了火线；其二，借力以四两拨千斤——秦未大举出兵而六国自相猜忌，成本之低源于'让对手的防御体系自己过载'；其三，顺流之中藏逆取——看似被动的'因'（利用既有矛盾）里包含主动的'导'（把矛盾引向爆炸的时机与方向），因势不是躺平而是精确的点火。方法论签名：最好的杠杆是敌人内部已有的裂缝。
modes.definition_en: Do not manufacture the current; capture and amplify the existing one. Contradictions, fears and appetites already inside the configuration are free fuel—the strategist's whole job is to route them toward outlets favorable to himself. The configuration lives inside the adversary: mutual suspicion between Qi and Chu, dread in Han and Wei pre-existed; Zhang Yi merely wired those points of distrust into a firing circuit. Leverage moves tons with ounces: Qin fought no great campaign while the six states suspected one another—the low cost came from letting the enemy's own defense system overload. And within the current hides the counter-seizure: the passive 'following' (因) contains the active 'steering' (导)—choosing when and where the contradiction detonates. Riding the current is not lying flat; it is precision ignition. Signature: the best lever is a crack the enemy already owns.
modes.source_chapter: 《史记·张仪列传》'楚绝齐，秦齐交强'诸段；《战国策·魏策一》
process_zh: 侦察裂缝：找出对手阵营中已存在的互疑、旧怨与利益冲突
选择干柴：判断哪一条裂缝最易被点燃、点燃后火烧连营
顺流点火：以最小动作（一句承诺、一个消息）引爆既有矛盾
借火取利：矛盾爆炸后立即收割格局变动产生的空间——盟约、土地或恐惧红利
process_en: Recon the cracks: find pre-existing suspicion, old grudges and conflicts of interest inside the adversary's camp
Pick the kindling: judge which crack ignites easiest and burns along the whole line
Ignite downstream: trigger the existing contradiction with a minimal move—a promise, a rumor
Harvest the fire: the moment it detonates, collect the space the upheaval opens—pacts, land, or the dividend of fear
modes.key_quote_zh: 因势利导——不点火者不知火势，善用火者不造火。
modes.key_quote_en: Follow the current and steer it—he who cannot read fire kindles nothing; he who masters fire never needs to strike the first spark.
representative_cases_zh: 借楚之贪毁齐楚之交：齐楚合纵本固，张仪不攻其盟而钓其王——楚王贪地绝齐，联盟自内断裂，秦不费一兵
借秦之强为说客之资：张仪一介策士能胁迫六国，所借之力全是秦国的现成国势——个人智慧嫁接在国家的既有力量上，如藤借树
反例警示：楚怀王入秦被扣，恰因忽视'秦之约'背后是'秦之势'——只看见承诺的善意而不见力量对比的走向，因势者的对手永远在帮你阅读你没读的账
representative_cases_en: Using Chu's greed to sever Qi-Chu: the vertical pact was solid, yet Zhang Yi never attacked the alliance—he angled for its king; the land-hungry king broke with Qi and the coalition snapped from within, at zero casualties

Borrowing Qin's might as the lobbyist's capital: a lone persuader overawed six states because every ounce of force was Qin's ready-made national power—personal wit grafted onto existing state strength, a vine borrowing a tree

Counter-case: King Huai was detained in Qin because he read the 'pact' and not the 'power' behind it—seeing goodwill in promises but not the trend in force; the rider of currents profits from exactly the ledger you failed to read
modern_applications_zh: 商战中利用竞对内部的产品线矛盾与渠道冲突
公关中的'借势营销'：嫁接既有热点而非自造热点
组织变革中的顺势推进：借既有的不满定点引爆议题
国际关系中的第三方矛盾利用
modern_applications_en: Exploiting rivals' internal product-line and channel conflicts
Newsjacking in PR: graft onto existing trends rather than minting new ones
Riding organizational discontent to detonate chosen reform issues
Third-party contradiction exploitation in international relations

modes.definition_zh: 旧联盟不能被'说服'解散，只能被'作废'重构：以拆散为起点、以重建为终点，破坏与建设是同一工程的两个工段。要害有三：其一，破有破的顺序——先断枢纽之盟（齐楚），再收外围之邦（韩魏），破的次序决定立的成本，乱破只会得到乱局而非新序；其二，立要用'既成事实'浇灌——每破一国立即以双边条约、割地、质子固定成果，让破坏的红利来不及流失；其三，立的新秩序以'不可逆'为标准——旧盟可散可聚，新约须使退出成本高于维持成本。方法论签名：拆除不是目的，地基上的新建筑才是；但请先拆干净，再画图纸。
modes.definition_en: An old coalition cannot be persuaded to dissolve; it must be voided and refounded. Demolition and construction are two sections of one project. Demolition has an order: cut the keystone pact first (Qi-Chu), then collect the periphery (Han-Wei)—the sequence of breaking sets the cost of building; random demolition yields chaos, not a new order. Building is watered with accomplished facts: break one state, immediately fix the gain with bilateral treaties, cessions and hostages, so the dividend of destruction never leaks away. And the new order is judged by irreversibility: the old pact could scatter and regather, but the new treaty must make exit costlier than adherence. Signature: demolition is not the goal—the building on the cleared foundation is; but clear the ground completely before drawing plans.
modes.source_chapter: 《史记·张仪列传》'张仪既相秦，为秦魏约'诸段；《战国策·秦策二》
process_zh: 绘新图：先想清楚'立'的终局形态，再反推'破'的施工顺序
断枢纽：先拆除联盟的承重结构，防止破散的成员重新聚拢
即破即固：每完成一处拆除，立即以条约与质子浇筑既成事实
抬高退出：新秩序的每一条款都使成员的退出成本高于维持成本，把临时倒戈变成永久归属
process_en: Draw the end-state first: conceive the 'building' before sequencing the demolition
Cut the keystone: remove the load-bearing pact first so the scattered members cannot regroup
Fix as you go: after each demolition, pour the gain into treaties and hostages at once
Raise exit costs: write every clause of the new order so leaving costs more than staying, turning defection into permanent membership
modes.key_quote_zh: 先破后立——破旧序易，立新序难；难在让新序不依赖破序者本人。
modes.key_quote_en: Demolish, then refound—breaking an old order is easy; founding a new one is hard, and hardest is making it survive its founder.
representative_cases_zh: 破纵而立连横：张仪拆散五国合纵的同时，逐国签订'事秦'之约、纳质割地——破掉的每一环都以双边条约的形式立进了秦主导的新秩序
相魏四年的'立'：张仪在魏为相四年，把魏从合纵骨干改造成连横样板——破坏者的身份最终转写为建设者，新序由旧敌的宰相在旧敌的朝廷里浇筑
反例警示：张仪去魏后魏再叛秦——新序依赖操作者个人的在场与手法，说明'立'的深度不足；制度化的不可逆才是重构的完成态
representative_cases_en: Breaking the vertical, founding the horizontal: while dismantling the five-state pact, Zhang Yi signed each state into 'serve-Qin' treaties with hostages and cessions—every broken ring was re-laid as a bilateral stone in Qin's new order

Four years of building in Wei: as Wei's chancellor for four years, Zhang Yi converted the backbone of the vertical alliance into the showcase of the horizontal—the demolisher's identity transcribed into a builder's, the new order poured by the old enemy's own chancellor in the old enemy's court

Counter-case: Wei defected again after Zhang Yi left—the new order depended on the operator's personal presence and touch, proving the 'building' never went deep; institutionalized irreversibility is the completed state of refounding
modern_applications_zh: 企业并购整合：先拆旧架构、即拆即固化协同条款
行业洗牌中的标准重建：让退出新标准比留在旧标准的成本更高
组织变革中的'先破后立'节奏管理
和平协议与政权重建中的不可逆条款设计
modern_applications_en: Post-merger integration: demolish the old structure, locking in synergy terms as you go
Standard-setting amid industry upheaval: make exit from the new standard costlier than staying in the old
Pacing 'demolish-then-refound' in organizational change
Irreversibility clauses in peace agreements and state reconstruction

modes.definition_zh: 对手的坚固不在城池而在认知：当正面强攻与常规谈判都撬不动时，针对对方的认知盲区与心理惯性定向投放假信息，让坚固的体系从内部按你的剧本自行运转。要害有三：其一，诈是针对'认知结构'的精确打击——楚怀王的贪、信与好面子，本身就是防线的图纸，张仪按图施工；其二，诈的成本结构极不对称——一句改口（六百里变六里）拆掉的是一国之盟，收益/成本比是冷兵器时代所有战法的顶点；其三，诈有伦理与信用账单——张仪的每一次得手都在消耗纵横家群体的公共信用，其终身逃亡式的外交生涯正是这份账单的分期偿还。方法论签名：最坚固的堡垒，永远从持有者的信念里开拆。
modes.definition_en: A foe's fortification lies in his cognition, not his walls: when frontal assault and ordinary negotiation both fail, deliver targeted false information into the target's blind spots and mental habits, and the fortified system runs your script from inside. Deception is precision strike on a cognitive structure: King Huai's greed, credulity and vanity were themselves the blueprint of his defense, and Zhang Yi built exactly to that drawing. The cost structure is wildly asymmetric—one re-wording (600 li becomes 6) demolished an alliance; the return-cost ratio crowns every cold-weapon tactic. But deception carries an ethics-and-credibility invoice: each success spent the persuasion school's public trust, and Zhang Yi's lifelong fugitive diplomacy was that invoice paid in installments. Signature: the strongest fortress is always dismantled from within its holder's own beliefs.
modes.source_chapter: 《史记·张仪列传》'仪说楚绝齐……楚使者往受地，张仪曰：仪与王约六里，不闻六百里'
process_zh: 绘认知地图：目标方的信念结构、信息来源与验证习惯全数入图
选诈点：找到图上验证成本最高、沉没成本最大的信念点下手
实施欺骗：以对方最愿意相信的形式投放假信息，配合真实履约的旧账增信
管理账单：预先计算被拆穿后的信用损失与报复路径，把欺诈的偿还安排进长期策略
process_en: Map cognition: chart the target's belief structure, information sources and verification habits
Pick the deception point: strike the belief node with the highest verification cost and greatest sunk cost
Execute: deliver the falsehood in the form the target most wants to believe, backed by real honored obligations for credibility
Manage the invoice: pre-compute the credibility loss and retaliation paths if exposed; schedule the repayment inside the long-term strategy
modes.key_quote_zh: 以诈破坚——兵不厌诈，然诈者终以身家偿还信用之债。
modes.key_quote_en: Deception against firmness—war spares no ruse, yet the deceiver repays credibility's debt with his own person.
representative_cases_zh: 六里之诈（前313年）：'仪与楚王约六里，不闻六百里'——一语改口，齐楚之盟已先自绝，楚军丹阳、蓝田两败，汉中六百里地反而入秦：欺诈的复利由对方的每一步错误自动滚出
诈欺的生涯成本：楚怀王'愿得张仪而甘心焉'，张仪竟敢自请入楚，凭靳尚与郑袖的运作全身而退——诈术的巅峰演出同时暴露其信用已破产到只能靠对手内部again拆解
反例警示：张仪后期说辞屡遭'秦，虎狼之国'的抵抗——欺诈的存量信任损耗抬高了后续所有谈判的利息
representative_cases_en: The six-li fraud (313 BC): 'I agreed on six li with your king, never six hundred'—one re-wording, yet the Qi-Chu pact was already self-severed; Chu lost at Danyang and Lantian, and its own 600 li of Hanzhong fell to Qin: deception's compound interest accrued from every wrong move the target made

The career cost of the con: with King Huai vowing to flay him alive, Zhang Yi voluntarily entered Chu and walked out whole via Jin Shang and Lady Zheng—his masterstroke simultaneously revealed a credit rating so ruined that survival depended on dismantling the enemy from inside yet again
Counter-case: later speeches met the refrain 'Qin is a state of wolves and tigers'—the stock of squandered trust raised the interest rate on every subsequent negotiation
modern_applications_zh: 网络安全中的社会工程学攻防
商战中的假动作与信息迷雾（及反欺诈尽调）
军事欺骗：伪装、佯动与认知域作战
谈判中的伦理红线管理：短期欺诈与长期信用的账务
modern_applications_en: Social engineering, attack and defense, in cybersecurity
Feints and information fog in business (and anti-fraud due diligence)
Military deception: camouflage, demonstrations, cognitive-domain operations
Ethical redlines in negotiation: booking short-term deception against long-term trust

modes.name_zh: 一使制多国外交杠杆法
modes.definition_zh: 个人以孤身之身介入多国博弈，其杠杆不是兵力而是'信息与信任的复用'：同一个人、同一套话术框架、同一张底牌，在不同宫廷间反复出入，每离开一国就带着该国的让步去压下一国。要害有三：其一，一使多国形成'信息套利'——使节独家掌握各国的让步底线与恐惧程度，任何一国都不知道别人已经让到哪一步；其二，个人信用是国家信用的前置代理——张仪的'秦相'身份使每句话都自带秦国国力背书，借国势抬人势，再以人势放大国势；其三，多国轮转是低成本的压力测试——每轮游说都在验证并修正整套战略，使节的行程本身就是一条实时反馈回路。方法论签名：一个人的行程单，可以比一支军队的补给线更决定战局。
modes.definition_en: One person, alone, enters a multi-state game; the leverage is not troops but the reuse of information and trust: the same man, one rhetorical frame, one hidden hand of cards, circulating court after court—leaving each state carrying its concession as pressure on the next. One envoy among many creates an information arbitrage: the envoy alone knows every state's bottom line and fear level, and no state knows how far the others have already yielded. Personal credit front-runs national credit: Zhang Yi's 'chancellor of Qin' identity backed every sentence with national power—borrowing state might to raise personal weight, then amplifying state might with personal weight. And the multi-state circuit is a low-cost stress test: each round validates and corrects the whole strategy; the itinerary itself is a real-time feedback loop. Signature: one man's itinerary can decide a war more than an army's supply line.
modes.source_chapter: 《史记·张仪列传》'张仪于是使楚……又使楚、韩、齐、赵、燕，以连横说诸侯'
process_zh: 铸身份：先取得足以调动国家信用的高位身份（秦相），使个人的每句话自带国力背书
设计行程：把多国按'杠杆传递链'排序，每一站的收获都是下一站的筹码
信息复用：在各国之间差异化披露——给每一国的说法都参考了别国已给出的让步
回路修正：每轮出使后复盘各国反应，实时修正下一轮的话术与要价
process_en: Forge the credential: first secure a high office that mobilizes national credit, so every personal sentence carries state backing
Design the itinerary: sequence the courts along a leverage-transmission chain—each stop's harvest is the next stop's chip
Reuse information: disclose differentially between states, each pitch referencing concessions others have already made
Close the loop: after each mission, review reactions and retune the next round's script and price
modes.key_quote_zh: 一使制多国——不怒自威者，身后有国；往来复用者，话里藏账。
modes.key_quote_en: One envoy subdues many states—awe without anger stands on a state behind him; the recycled message conceals a ledger between courts.
representative_cases_zh: 三度使楚、五国轮转：张仪先后出使楚、韩、齐、赵、燕，把'秦已许某国何利、某国已献何地'的信息差逐国投放——合纵六国在不知彼此底牌的情况下被逐个翻转
自请入楚的胆识杠杆：以孤身入虎穴证明'秦楚可亲'，把个人安危本身变成外交信用——一人之冒险换来楚国之转变
反例警示：张仪一死、秦武王逐纵横家——个人杠杆的全部张力系于个人，使节不在场时信息套利即刻消失，六国复纵
representative_cases_en: Three missions to Chu, a circuit of five: Zhang Yi toured Chu, Han, Qi, Zhao and Yan, planting country by country the information gap of 'what Qin has offered and what others have ceded'—the six vertical-ally states were flipped one by one, none seeing another's cards

Courage as leverage: volunteering alone into the tiger's den of Chu to prove 'Qin and Chu can be friends,' he turned his own person into diplomatic credit—one man's gamble bought a state's realignment

Counter-case: Zhang Yi died, King Wu of Qin expelled the persuaders—the entire tension of personal leverage hung on the person; the moment the envoy left the board, the information arbitrage vanished and the vertical alliance re-formed
modern_applications_zh: 跨国并购中的首席谈判代表机制
多边谈判中的穿梭外交（shuttle diplomacy）
商务开发中的'同一人跑多家客户'信息套利与合规边界
VC/FA在多家竞购方之间的信息复用
modern_applications_en: Chief-negotiator mechanisms in cross-border M&A
Shuttle diplomacy in multilateral talks
Information arbitrage of one rainmaker across multiple clients—and its compliance bounds
Banker reuse of information among competing bidders

modes.definition_zh: 把最重的战略资产（土地）轻量化为谈判筹码：土地不必真给，只需被精确地'报价'——报价本身就是武器，它同时完成三件事：抬高对方预期、撬动对方与盟友的关系、为日后改口预设空间。要害有三：其一，筹码与所有权的分离——张仪始终没有支配商於之地的真实权力，六百里是'秦王的许诺'而非张仪的资产，杠杆的妙处在用不属于自己的资源下注；其二，报价的规模按'杠杆需求'而非'实际价值'设计——六百里大到足以让楚国冒绝齐之险，六里小到足以让秦无损；其三，土地之饵要换的是结构性收益（齐楚之盟的解体、汉中的易手），不是交易本身的对价。方法论签名：用你并不拥有的东西，换走对手真正拥有的东西。
modes.definition_en: Convert the heaviest strategic asset—land—into a light bargaining chip: the land need never be given, only precisely 'quoted,' and the quote itself is the weapon. It does three jobs at once: inflates the target's expectation, pries apart the target and its ally, and pre-reserves room to renege. Chip and ownership are separate: Zhang Yi never controlled Shang land—the 600 li were 'the King of Qin's promise,' not Zhang Yi's asset; the genius of the lever is betting resources you do not own. The quote is sized to leverage needed, not intrinsic value: 600 li, big enough to make Chu risk breaking with Qi; 6 li, small enough to cost Qin nothing. And the territorial bait buys structural returns—the dissolution of the Qi-Chu pact, the transfer of Hanzhong—not the consideration of the transaction itself. Signature: trade what you do not own for what your opponent truly owns.
modes.source_chapter: 《史记·张仪列传》'秦愿献商於之地六百里'与'仪与王约六里'；《战国策·楚策一》
process_zh: 选饵：找出对方最渴望、己方不必真付的战略资产，取得'报价权'而非'所有权'
定标：按撬动目标关系网所需的力度设计报价规模，而非按资产实际价值
收构：以对方兑现'先决条件'（绝齐）为兑现前提，让饵的价格由对方的行动支付
改口锁利：目标达成后按新解释重写对价，把结构性收益（联盟解体、领土易手）落袋
process_en: Choose the bait: find the strategic asset the target craves and you need never actually pay; secure the 'quoting right,' not ownership
Size the quote: set the offer by the force needed to pry the target's relationship network, not by the asset's intrinsic worth
Collect structurally: make payment conditional on the target's 'preconditions' (breaking with Qi), so the bait's price is paid by the target's own actions
Re-word and lock: once the goal is met, rewrite the consideration under a fresh reading, banking the structural returns—the broken alliance, the changed territory
modes.key_quote_zh: 以地为饵——六百里是钩，六里是价：饵饵相扣，土地未出而汉中已入。
modes.key_quote_en: Land as bait—600 li the hook, 6 li the price: hook within hook; no land left Qin, and Hanzhong came in.
representative_cases_zh: 商於六百里钓楚（前313年）：饵未支付而钩已咬死——楚绝齐、齐楚盟散、秦齐转而结好，楚怒而攻秦反失丹阳、汉中：一纸报价撬动四国格局
汉中的结构收益：楚怀王两败后'愿以黔中地易张仪'，张仪自请入楚而秦得黔中——土地之饵的终点是土地的净流入，秦以'不给'换'多得'
反例警示：楚怀王客死于秦，楚人皆怜之——以地为饵赢得战争，却输掉了楚国对秦的一切信任，为后来'楚虽三户，亡秦必楚'埋下百年复仇叙事
representative_cases_en: 600 li of Shang angled Chu (313 BC): the bait was never paid, yet the hook was set—Chu broke with Qi, the pact dissolved, Qin and Qi drew together, and when Chu attacked in fury it lost Danyang and Hanzhong: one paper offer moved a four-state board

Hanzhong as structural return: after two defeats King Huai offered Qianzhong land merely for Zhang Yi's person; Zhang Yi went voluntarily and Qin took Qianzhong—the territorial bait's terminus was net territorial inflow: Qin paid nothing and gained much

Counter-case: King Huai died a captive in Qin and all Chu mourned him—winning the war with territorial bait, Qin lost every shred of Chu's trust, seeding the century-long revenge narrative 'even three households of Chu will bury Qin'
